emergency_key_notice: Important: PIN marandhutta recovery panna indha Emergency Key-ai safe-aa save pannikonga.
stage_1_desc: Authentication, PostgreSQL database, Multi-tenant and Currency rules active-aa irukku.
onboarding_subtitle: Unga kadai epdi nadakudhu nu sollunga, Kanakku adhe maadhiri customize aagum.
onboarding_banner_desc: Unga business-ukku thevaiyaana features-ai activate panna setup-ai complete pannunga.
step1_desc: Unga kadai peyar matrum enna maadhiri business?
step2_desc: Aalunga adhigama irundhaale software complex aaga thevai illa. Motha aalunga ethana per, idhula Kanakku use panna poravanga ethana per?
hint_workforce: Cook, driver, helper, delivery boy ellarum serthu.
hint_app_users: Bill podura cashier, manager, account paapavanga.
step3_desc: Ungalukku ethana branch kadai illa godown irukku?
step4_desc: Unga kadaile enna maadhiri viyabaaram nadakudhu? (Thevaianadha select pannunga)
step5_desc: Dhinamum stock count matrum supplier purchase order paaka venduma?
label_tracks_inventory: Porutkalin stock count track panna venduma?
yes_tracks_inventory: Aama, daily stock count matrum low-stock alert venum
no_tracks_inventory: Illa, stock count venaam, direct fast billing mattum
yes_purchase_orders: Aama, Purchase Orders pottu Goods check pannanum
no_purchase_orders: Illa, porul vandhavudane direct bill poduvom
step6_desc: Raw material vachu pudhu porul seireengala illa Expiry date paaka venduma?
label_raw_materials: Raw materials matrum Recipe (BOM) track pannanuma?
label_production_batches: Batch number matrum lot number track pannanuma?
label_scrap_wastage: Wastage matrum scrap kanakkil vaikka venduma?
step7_desc: Customer-kku kadan thareengala? Supplier-kku baaki bill track panna venduma?
hint_customer_credit: Customer baaki, WhatsApp reminder, credit limit ellam podalaam.
label_supplier_payments: Supplier-kku thara vendiya Baaki Bill track pannanuma?
hint_supplier_payments: Supplier-ku evlo kudukanum nu accurate-aa therinjukalaam.
step8_desc: Staff-kku thani permissions matrum Manager approval rules thevaiya?
label_staff_permissions: Staff permission pirikka venduma (Cashier vs Manager)?
hint_staff_permissions: Cashier profit paaka mudiyadhu, bill mattum podalaam.
label_approval_workflows: Bill cancel panna manager approval thevaiya?
step9_desc: Neengalum unga staff-um Kanakku app-ai entha mozhiyila use panna virumbureenga?
lang_tanglish: Tanglish — Tamil in English script (e.g., 'Bill Podunga')
step10_desc: Fast billing-kku yetha maadhiri screen-ai maathikkonga:
label_high_contrast: High Contrast Mode (Veyililum theliva theriyura dark border)
label_simplified_ui: Minimalist Counter Screen (Rush time-la thevaiyilladha button-ai maraikkum)
review_desc: Unga business-kku yetha recommendation varathukku munnadi oru thadava check pannikonga.
recommendation_desc: Unga kadaiyin operational scale-kku yetha maadhiri namma rule engine recommend seivadhu:
tier_simple_tagline: Super Fast, Thevaiyilladha Confusion Illadha Counter Billing
tier_simple_desc: Chinna kadaigalukku romba perfect. Big buttons, clear screens, instant bill printing.
tier_growth_desc: Growing retail, wholesale matrum workshop-kku yethadhu. Average cost, khata ledger, PO.
tier_enterprise_desc: Neriya branches, factories, multi-level approvals thevaipadum periya business-ukku.
owner_choice_prompt: Unga viruppam thaan mukkiyam. Ungalukku thevaiyaana tier-ai select pannunga:
toggle_module_hint: Settings-la eppo venaalum indha module-ai on/off pannikolaam.
completion_desc: Unga workspace {tier}-kku yetha maadhiri ready aaiduchu. Settings-la eppo venaalum maathalaam.
profile_settings_desc: Unga business configuration, tier matrum active modules-ai paarkavum.
